name: cashpilot
description: CashPilot is a self-hosted passive income orchestrator. Deploy, manage, and monitor bandwidth-sharing, DePIN, storage, and GPU compute Docker containers from a single web dashboard. Tracks earnings across 49 services with historical charts and trend analysis. This is the UI container. It provides the web dashboard, earnings collection, service catalog, and fleet management. It does NOT require Docker socket access. You also need the CashPilot Worker container on each server where you want to deploy passive income services. The worker manages Docker containers and reports back to this UI. Set the same CASHPILOT_API_KEY on both the UI and all workers to authenticate them. More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/CashPilot

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Port for the CashPilot web dashboard

variables.name: API Key
variables.description: Shared API key for worker authentication. Must match the key set on all CashPilot Worker instances.

variables.name: Secret Key
variables.description: Encryption key for stored service credentials (Fernet). Auto-generated if left empty.
